## Iron Mountain Ranch facts (verified August 2026)
- 850-acre master-planned community in Centennial Hills / northwest Las Vegas
- ~9 villages, ~1,700 homes, built primarily 2001–2008
- ZIP codes: 89131 and 89143
- Median list price ~$535,000 (~$235/sq ft); ~27 days on market; ~28 active listings
- Landscape Maintenance Association (LMA) + village HOAs; typical combined dues ~$95–$185/mo
- Homes mostly 2,000–4,500 sq ft on larger lots; Gass Peak / Sheep Range views
